title: ProBuilderMesh core data structures
extract: FIELDS: List every serialized/internal field with type, default, and purpose
MESH REPRESENTATION: How vertices, faces, edges, shared vertices, UV channels are stored. Array layouts. Index formats.
SUBMESH STRUCTURE: How materials map to submeshes, how triangles are grouped
REFRESH PIPELINE: What Refresh(RefreshMask) does step by step - when does ToMesh/Refresh get called, what does each mask bit rebuild
SELECTION STATE: How selected faces/edges/vertices are stored and queried per-mesh
LIFECYCLE: Creation, destruction, MakeUnique, undo integration, prefab support

title: Face, Edge, Vertex, SharedVertex types
extract: FACE: All fields (indexes, smoothingGroup, textureGroup, manualUV, submeshIndex, elementGroup). How indexes relate to mesh vertex array. Distinct vs shared vertex semantics.
EDGE: Local vs common edge representation. EdgeLookup purpose. How edges reference vertices.
VERTEX: All 8 channels (position, color, uv0-3, normal, tangent). Equals/hash semantics.
SHARED VERTEX: Mapping from local index to shared index. Purpose for welding, merging. GetSharedVertexLookup.
NORMAL CALCULATION: CalculateNormals algorithm - per-face, per-smoothing-group averaging. Hard vs soft edge normals.

title: Enums, preferences, and configuration
extract: EVERY ENUM: List every enum with every member and its numeric value. SelectMode, ComponentMode, EditLevel, EntityType, ColliderType, ProjectionAxis, HandleAxis, Axis, WindingOrder, SortMethod, CullingMode, RectSelectMode, MeshSyncState, MeshArrays, IndexFormat, RefreshMask, ExtrudeMethod.
HANDLE ORIENTATION: World vs ActiveObject vs ActiveElement - exact behavior of each for vertex/edge/face
PIVOT POINT: How pivot calculation works per selection
AUTO UNWRAP SETTINGS: All fields (offset, rotation, scale, fill, stretch, anchor, swapUV, flipU, flipV, useWorldSpace) with their meaning
UNWRAP PARAMETERS: hardAngle, packMargin, angleError, areaError
PREFERENCE KEYS: Every preference key string, its type, and default value
RECT SELECT: Partial vs Complete intersection behavior
SELECTION MODIFIER: Add, Subtract, Difference behavior with shift/ctrl

title: Math, projection, snapping utilities
extract: SNAPPING: Snap(value, snap) algorithm. ProGrids integration. How grid snapping works during vertex/face/edge movement.
MATH: All static methods - ray-face intersection, triangle area, normal calculation, point-in-polygon, closest point on edge/face/line, polygon centroid, signed angle
PROJECTION: How 3D faces are projected to 2D for UV operations and triangulation. FindBestPlane, PlanarProject.
HANDLE UTILITY: ScreenToGuiPoint, GetActiveCamera, FaceRaycast, edge picking distance calculations
BOUNDS 2D: Axis-aligned bounding box for UV/2D operations
INT VECTORS: Why they exist (hash-based comparison with epsilon tolerance)

title: Extrude, Inset, Offset
extract: FACE EXTRUDE: ExtrudeMethod.IndividualFaces vs VertexNormal vs FaceNormal - geometry algorithm for each. How new faces/vertices are created.
EDGE EXTRUDE: How edge extrusion creates new faces along edges
INSET: How Shift+Scale creates inset faces. The algorithm - scale face inward, create bridge faces.
OFFSET: How offset differs from extrude. Distance parameter behavior.
SHIFT+MOVE EXTRUDE: The Shift+Move shortcut that auto-extrudes faces/edges during translation. Exact trigger conditions and state machine.
UX FLOW: What happens click-by-click. When does the extrusion commit? Undo behavior.

title: Connect, Bridge, Subdivide, InsertEdgeLoop
extract: CONNECT EDGES: Algorithm - finds face(s) sharing selected edges, inserts new edge(s). How it handles quads vs n-gons.
CONNECT VERTICES: Connects selected vertices within a face with new edge(s). Algorithm.
BRIDGE EDGES: Creates face(s) between two selected edges. Requirements (same object, edges must share no face). Algorithm.
SUBDIVIDE EDGES: Splits edges into N segments. subdivisions parameter.
SUBDIVIDE FACES: Center vertex + connecting edges. Algorithm for quad vs n-gon.
INSERT EDGE LOOP: Full loop detection algorithm. How it follows quad strips. What happens at non-quad faces.
SMART CONNECT/SUBDIVIDE: Mode-aware dispatch logic

title: Delete, Detach, Duplicate, Merge, Collapse, Split, Weld, Bevel
extract: DELETE: How faces are removed. Orphan vertex cleanup. Shared vertex cleanup.
DETACH: Detach to new object vs detach in place. How it duplicates vertices and creates separate submeshes.
DUPLICATE: Creates new object from selected faces. Difference from detach.
MERGE FACES: When allowed (adjacent, same smoothing/material). Algorithm.
COLLAPSE: Collapse to first vs collapse to center. Vertex merging algorithm.
SPLIT: Unshares a vertex - duplicates it so faces don't share it. Reverses welding.
WELD: Distance-based vertex welding. Threshold parameter. SharedVertex update.
BEVEL: Edge bevel algorithm - distance parameter, how new faces are created at beveled edges. Face bevel.
FILL HOLE: Hole detection from selected edges/vertices. How the fill polygon is triangulated.
FLIP FACE EDGE: Flips shared triangle edge between two triangles.
CONFORM NORMALS: Makes all face normals point same direction. Algorithm.
SET PIVOT: How pivot point is moved to selection center while keeping geometry in place.

title: Mesh transforms and vertex positioning
extract: VERTEX POSITIONING: TranslateVertices, SetVertexPosition - how positions are applied in world vs local space. How SharedVertex groups move together.
MESH TRANSFORM: FreezeTransform algorithm - bakes transform into vertices and resets transform. MirrorObject - axis selection, how UVs/normals are flipped.
SURFACE TOPOLOGY: GetConnectedFaces, GetConnectedEdges, WingedEdge traversal for topology queries
VERTEX EDITING: AppendSharedVertex, SetSharedVertex - maintaining the shared vertex map during edits
MESH VALIDATION: RemoveDegenerateTriangles, RemoveUnusedVertices, EnsureMeshIsValid

title: UV Editor window
extract: WINDOW LAYOUT: All UI elements, panels, toolbars. What each button/dropdown does.
UV MANIPULATION: How UVs are moved, rotated, scaled in the UV editor. Gizmo behavior.

UV EDITING OPERATIONS: SewUVs, SplitUVs, CollapseUVs, ProjectFacesBox, ProjectFacesPlanar, ProjectFacesAuto
TEXTURE GROUPS: How textureGroup field groups faces for coordinated UV projection

SHAPE GENERATOR (legacy): All static generation methods. Parameters for each.

BEZIER SHAPE: Tangent handle types. Knot placement. How bezier curve becomes mesh (tessellation parameter). Surface generation from spline.
BEZIER EDITING: Moving knots vs tangent handles. Inserting/deleting control points.
